description: This PHP class 'PartialTheme' is part of the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the 'CorporateBranding' plugin. It models a partial theme with properties such as id, name, variables, and filenames for logos and banners. It includes a constructor, getter methods, and a static factory method to create an instance from a 'Theme' entity.

classes.name: PartialTheme
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing a partial theme configuration with associated properties and factory method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes all properties of the PartialTheme with provided values.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the theme.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the theme.

methods.name: getVariables
methods.description: Returns the array of variables associated with the theme.

methods.name: showSocialMediaIcons
methods.description: Returns whether social media icons should be shown.

methods.name: getClientLogoFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the client logo.

methods.name: getClientBannerFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the client banner.

methods.name: getLoginBannerFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the login banner.

methods.name: createFromTheme
methods.description: Static factory method to create a PartialTheme instance from a Theme object.
